title: CAIS, CAISI and Societal-Scale Risk — Categories of Societal Risk

desc: Societal-scale AI risk is often grouped into malicious use, accidents, competitive pressure and loss of control.
objectives: Name the main categories of AI risk.

title: CAIS, CAISI and Societal-Scale Risk — Reasoning About Uncertain Large Risks
titleKn: CAIS, CAISI ಮತ್ತು ಸಮಾಜ-ಮಟ್ಟದ ಅಪಾಯ — ಅನಿಶ್ಚಿತ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಪಾಯಗಳ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ತರ್ಕ
desc: Large-scale AI risk is uncertain and contested, so reason with evidence, scenarios and humility.
objectivesKn: ಅತಿ ಮತ್ತು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ ಎರಡನ್ನೂ ಪರಿಗಣಿಸಿ.
